description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'BuzzAnniversaryDao' used for retrieving and counting upcoming employee anniversaries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for constructing database queries with filters related to employee anniversary dates.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class responsible for fetching employee upcoming anniversaries and counts based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Returns a list of upcoming employee anniversaries matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object configured with the query to fetch employee anniversaries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of upcoming employee anniversaries matching the filter parameters.
